verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a REST API for running and managing models (ollama-gh-4) and documents curl/Python/JS usage (ollama-docs-9/10/11), suggesting core model operations (pull, run, chat) are API-accessible, matching much of the CLI/GUI functionality. However, there is no explicit documentation or comparison confirming full parity between the desktop app/UI and the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (ollama-probe-3), leaving completeness unverified. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API feature parity documentation, OpenAPI/spec confirming full endpoint coverage, and evidence that newer GUI-only features (e.g. app settings) are also exposed via API.
